# group: # One line per logical package. "-" means "not packaged / not needed on this distro".
# Names that turn out to be unavailable at install time are skipped with a warning,
# and the fallbacks in lib/extras.sh fill the gaps for a few important tools.
# ---- core: everything a working desktop session needs, regardless of X11/Wayland

arch: xorg-server xorg-xinit xorg-xrandr xorg-xset xorg-xinput xorg-xprop xorg-xrdb xorg-xkill xorg-xsetroot
void: xorg-minimal xinit xrandr xset xinput xprop xrdb xkill xsetroot

debian: nodejs npm python3-pip golang rustc cargo
